title: query_shapes
description: H1 — the estate's canonical query shapes, selected from the history corpus by composite trust. One entry per distinct structural skeleton, represented by its most-adopted query.

slices.description: slice name -> how many shapes it holds; the authoring stage bundles per slice

enum_vals.description: observed literals: {column: [values]} where the miner knew the column, a flat list where it did not

user_names.description: WHO asked this skeleton across its collapsed members, sorted. Present only with pii.redact_user_names: false, and only in the run directory: no publish destination accepts a user name.

observed_values.description: literals the collapsed members of this skeleton carried, shaped by policy. Null where the shape had none.

adoption.description: why the shape was admitted: corroborated by several analysts, the best of one analyst's, or from a source that records no adoption at all (a pre-aggregated source) — not a claim that anyone ran it.

query_ids.description: logged query ids this skeleton was executed as, across every collapsed member, sorted and capped at history_corpus.query_ids_per_shape. Empty when the source names no ids.

n_query_ids.description: how many logged query ids the skeleton had in all; greater than len(query_ids) when the cap bit

query_ids_digest.description: SHA-256 over the sorted per-statement digests of the FULL id lists (query_corpus.jsonl query_ids_sha256), so a truncated list stays checkable

first_seen.description: earliest logged start time of any member

last_seen.description: latest logged start time of any member
